title: Concatenation Of Consecutive Binary Numbers
description:
Given an integer `n`, concatenate the binary representations of the integers from `1` through `n`, in that order. Return the resulting value as a decimal integer modulo `10^9 + 7`.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 1
```

```text
Input: n = 3
Output: 27
```

```text
Input: n = 12
Output: 505379714
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^5`
